text: Source qualification found a real parser gap before acceptance: complete C023.asc uses SAMPLES GAZE LEFT RATE 250 TRACKING CR FILTER 2, with every sample carrying a trailing three-character token (typically ...). Current EyeLinkAscSamples.expectedFieldCount does not incorporate trackingEvidence and rejects the extra column. Preserve entire file bytes; add named tracking-flag support and tests rather than preprocessing it away. Source checksum remains c23a7fb86d2fa4d7dcd8578a06f82911214073f1b6d36536bc9bc39316d70b19. SR Research ASC guide https://www.sr-research.com/download/dispdoc/page25.html consulted; obtain manufacturer manual evidence for exact CR flag semantics before implementation.
